'''What changed:''' the words and numbers are unchanged; the credit line, printed in January 2007 sideways in the slip's side margins (“Original concept by Reid Smith” / “Origins US Nationals 2005”), now runs along the bottom of the text box as one line: “Original concept by Reid Smith     Origins US Nationals 2005”. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
